contexts.name: expenses
contexts.purpose: Expense categories and subcategories a user owns, and the expenses recorded under them.

terms.meaning: A person identified by their email address.
A named grouping of expenses that belongs to a user and is unique among that user's categories.
A named detail under one expense-category, unique within that category and deletable with it.
An amount spent on a date, attributed either to an expense-category or to one of its expense-subcategories.

tasks.title: Manage expense-categories
tasks.goal: A user can create, edit and delete the expense-categories that group their expenses.
criteria: A user can create an expense-category with a name and receives it back.
A user can rename an existing expense-category and delete an existing one.
Creating or renaming to a name the same user already uses for another expense-category is refused.
Every category created is owned by the requesting user.

tasks.title: List the user's expense-categories
tasks.goal: A user can see all their expense-categories, including the list shown alongside the creation form.
criteria: A user can request the list of their expense-categories and receives each name.
The list contains only the requested user's expense-categories, never another user's.
A user with no expense-categories receives an empty list, and requesting the list without a known user is rejected.

tasks.title: Manage expense-subcategories
tasks.goal: A user can create, edit and delete as many expense-subcategories as needed under an expense-category.
criteria: A user can create an expense-subcategory under an expense-category they own.
A user can rename an expense-subcategory and delete it.
Creating or renaming to a name already used by a subcategory of the same expense-category is refused, while the same name under a different expense-category is allowed.
Deleting an expense-category deletes all of its expense-subcategories in cascade.
Acting on an expense-category or expense-subcategory the user does not own is refused.

tasks.title: List the expense-subcategories of a category
tasks.goal: A user can see the expense-subcategories belonging to one expense-category.
criteria: A user can request the expense-subcategories of an expense-category they own and receives each name.
The list contains only subcategories of the requested expense-category, and only for a category the user owns.
An expense-category with no expense-subcategory returns an empty list.
Asking for the expense-subcategories of an expense-category that does not exist is not found.
After an expense-category is deleted its expense-subcategories are no longer listed.
out_of_scope: Subcategories across several categories at once

tasks.title: Register an expense
tasks.goal: A user can register an expense, attributed to an expense-category without subcategories or to one of its expense-subcategories.
criteria: A user can create an expense with an amount greater than 0, a date defaulting to today, and a target that is either an owned expense-category with no expense-subcategory or an owned expense-subcategory.
A user can edit and delete an expense they own.
Editing an expense may change its amount, its date and the category or subcategory it belongs to.
An amount of 0 or less is refused and no expense is stored.
A target that is not owned by the user, or that does not exist, is refused.
The owning user is recorded with the expense but is never accepted as input nor returned to the user.
An expense-category that still has expense-subcategories is refused as a target.

tasks.title: List expenses ordered by date
tasks.goal: A user can see the expenses listed under the registration form, newest information first by date.
criteria: A user can request their expenses and receives amount, date and the category or subcategory each belongs to.
Expenses are returned ordered by date, newest date first.
Expenses that share a date are ordered by when they were created, newest first.
The list contains only the requested user's expenses.
After an expense is deleted it no longer appears in the list.
A user with no expenses receives an empty list, and requesting the list without a known user is rejected.
